objects.summary: Builder confirms B4 tie-break repair in 20d7568ef4: compute global maximum first, then choose smallest L within 1e-12; exact chained near-tie and variants are tested.

Builder confirms late-mutation repair in 20d7568ef4: when post-write filesystem integrity fails, result artifact is rewritten INVALID_INPUT with return_code 3 and reason, preventing durable JSON from falsely advertising a valid run.

P2 coordination review finds a deleted remote branch can remain under refs/remotes/origin after fetch reports couldn't find remote ref, causing stale local tracking state to be displayed as existing or NEW. Remote absence must dominate stale tracking refs or pruning must occur.
P3 review finds 12-hour team-balance metric counts textual A2-TEAM role headers without authenticating GitHub author/footer, so a third party can spoof imbalance and trigger false rebalancing advice.
Builder confirms remote-absence handling fixed in 0f30ac8eee: a branch whose fetch says remote ref absent is displayed absent regardless of stale local tracking ref, without mutating local refs.

cross_object_findings.finding: The B4 tie-break and persistent-artifact findings were not left as review prose; same-lineage fixes and dedicated tests closed both before economic execution.
Coordination logic can falsely resurrect deleted branches if remote fetch absence is not treated as authoritative over stale local refs.
Even a non-authoritative balance metric can steer work allocation; actor identity checks must match those used by the watchdog before role counts are trusted.
